promptSet.title: Automated Git Commit & Changelog Generator
promptSet.prompt: Analyze git diff HEAD~1. Categorize all modifications according to Conventional Commits (feat, fix, refactor, chore). Generate a concise semantic commit message and an updated release notes entry.
instructions: Install the Claude Code CLI utility in your local terminal.
Add this prompt to your custom skills directory.
Trigger automated commit analysis before pushing branch updates.
promptSet.exampleOutput: feat(auth): implement PKCE authorization flow with refresh token rotation
